glassblower.summary: A young glassblower with orange hair, goggles on the head, a teal shirt, and a leather apron. The model is close to the mockup, and the differences are small.
strengths: The hair, the goggles, the teal shirt, the leather apron, and the boots match the mockup palette.
The blowpipe with the orange bubble and the teal glass vase read clearly in every view and in the sprites.
The glass vase is translucent, and the metal, leather, and cloth materials are different.
issues: The lower end of the blowpipe is a bent metal hook. Make it a soft hose that curves back to the waist, as in the mockup.
The goggle lenses are light blue. Make them a dark amber tint with a brass rim, as in the mockup.
The glass bubble is pale orange. Make it brighter and more emissive so that it shows as hot glass.
From the side, the goggles look like a flat plate on the hair. Give the lenses more depth.
The walk moves only the legs. The arms and the pipe stay fixed.
glassblower.next: Replace the bent hook at the lower end of the blowpipe with a hose that curves back to the waist.

gravedigger.summary: A kind old cemetery keeper with a flat cap, a green scarf, a muddy gray coat, a lantern, and a spade. The character is the same, but the short beard and the tall spade are clear differences.
strengths: The flat cap, the green scarf, the mud stains, and the pink nose match the mockup.
The face is gentle and friendly. The character is not scary.
The lantern and the spade read in the sprites from most directions.
issues: The beard covers only the chin. Make it a long, full beard that falls onto the chest and covers the top of the scarf, as in the mockup.
The spade handle goes above the cap. Shorten it so that the top is at shoulder height, and make it a plain wooden shaft without knobs.
The lantern glow is weak. Make the glass a bright yellow with more emission.
The coat is short and looks like a skirt. Make it a longer open coat with lapels, pockets, and a visible belt buckle.
The mud stains on the boots and the coat look like camouflage. Make them fewer and darker.
The walk moves only the legs. The arms and the tools stay fixed.
gravedigger.next: Make the beard long and full so that it falls onto the chest, as in the mockup.

jeweler.summary: A jeweler with a monocle, a black beard, a purple vest, a gem on a handle, and a ring box. The props and the clothes match, but the face and the hair are noticeably off.
strengths: The purple vest with gold chains, the white sleeves, the gold buckle, and the glossy black shoes match the mockup.
The gem on the gold handle, the red ring box with the ring, and the gold monocle read well.
The materials are clear: gold metal, faceted gem, velvet box, and glossy shoes.
issues: The mouth is not visible. The mockup shows a big open smile with teeth under the curled mustache. Add the open smile.
The hair is a tall block with ridges, like a helmet. Make it a swept-back pompadour with volume at the sides, as in the mockup.
From the side, the face skin has a hard straight edge against the beard and the hair. Blend the sideburn and the beard into the face.
The nose is small. Make it a large round pink nose, as in the mockup.
The walk moves only the legs. The arms and the props stay fixed.
jeweler.next: Add the open smile with teeth under the mustache so that the expression matches the mockup.

librarian.summary: An old librarian with a gray bun, round black glasses, a mint coat, a green skirt, and a stack of books. The model is close to the mockup, and the differences are small.
strengths: The gray bun, the round glasses, and the gentle smile give a clear and kind face.
The stack of colored books in both hands reads clearly in the front views and in the sprites.
The mint coat, the cream blouse, the green skirt, and the brown shoes match the mockup palette.
issues: The coat stops at the hip. Make it a longer open coat that goes down near the hem of the skirt, as in the mockup.
The eyes are brown. Make them teal green, as in the mockup.
The coat has a strong diagonal stripe texture. Make the cloth smoother.
On the back of the head, the hair strands look like fingers that hold the head. Make the strands flatter and sweep them up to the bun.
The walk moves only the feet under the skirt. The arms and the books stay fixed.
librarian.next: Make the coat longer so that it frames the skirt down to the hem, as in the mockup.

lumberjack.summary: A bearded lumberjack in a gray beanie and a plaid shirt with an axe on the shoulder and hands on the hips. The character is the same, but the sleeves and the arms are clearly different from the mockup.
strengths: The gray knit beanie, the bushy brown beard, and the happy smile match the mockup.
The axe on the shoulder and the hands on the hips give a strong silhouette in the front view and in the sprites.
The red and black plaid, the suspenders, and the belt buckle read clearly.
issues: The sleeves are plain red and go down to the fists. Make short plaid sleeves rolled up above bare, strong forearms, as in the mockup.
The arms are not muscular enough. Make the forearms and the upper arms larger to show the defining strength.
The trousers look like a short skirt. Make them gray trousers with visible legs down to the boot cuffs.
The nose is small. Make it a large round pink nose, as in the mockup.
The axe handle goes down across the back. Make it go horizontally behind the neck, as in the mockup.
lumberjack.next: Give the shirt short plaid rolled sleeves and show large bare forearms.

magistrate.summary: A judge with white hair, round black glasses, a black robe, a gavel, and a book. The identity reads, but the hair and the face are noticeably off.
strengths: The round black glasses, the white jabot, the black robe, the gavel, and the book make the role clear.
The character reads in the sprites from every direction.
The robe, the book, and the gavel have clean shapes with no poke-through.
issues: The mouth is not visible. The mockup shows a gentle closed smile. Add the smile.
The hair locks point out to the sides like horns. Make round, soft waves that sit close to the head, as in the mockup.
The robe has a red sash at the waist. Remove the sash and show a red waistcoat under an open black robe.
The red collar is small. Make the red hood collar large around the neck, as in the mockup.
The fists are white. Make them skin color with white cuffs.
The eyebrows are faint. Make them orange and thick, as in the mockup.
magistrate.next: Add the gentle smile and make the hair round soft waves that sit close to the head.

mason.summary: A young mason with a tan cap, freckles, a blue shirt, a tan apron, a trowel, and a stone block. The character is the same, but the trowel and some colors are clearly different.
strengths: The tan cap, the freckles, and the friendly smile match the mockup.
The stone block has a good rough texture and reads clearly in the sprites.
The apron with brown straps and belt, the tan trousers, and the gray boots match the mockup.
issues: The trowel is a small diamond blade. Make it a large flat trowel blade, larger than the hand, as in the mockup.
The hair is orange red. Make it a golden caramel color with curls, as in the mockup.
The sleeves go down to the fists. Roll the sleeves up above bare forearms, as in the mockup.
The nose is small. Make it a round pink nose, as in the mockup.
The hair strands under the cap look like they melt down at the back. Make clean curls.
mason.next: Make the trowel a large flat blade so that the role reads at 128 px.
